title: fix(system-status): show last-used time on all spawned claude processes
context:
Claude/agy processes discovered via the ps scan (not CCC's own spawn
registry) always rendered "started": "" — no relative timestamp in the
System status panel's Spawned processes list, unlike registry-tracked
entries. ps now also reports etime, which lets us back-compute a start
timestamp for these rows too.

- server.py: `ps -A -o pid,ppid,rss,etime,command`, new
  _parse_ps_etime_s() parses '[[dd-]hh:]mm:ss', claude_results rows get
  a real "started" timestamp instead of ""
 What changed: ad
